data.text/markdown:
Webcam → DA3 → depth and cloud

Open http://127.0.0.1:8768 for RGB, depth and a colored cloud together. Depth is relative estimated geometry, not metres. Frames are undistorted using the measured webcam calibration. Point stride controls cloud density. Retain the model and camera cells while revising processing. Close the current viewer before replacing its display cell. Call viewer.close() and workbench.close() when done. See DEPTH_COMPARISON.md for measurements.
